system.description:
KORNARGON SHADOW

The shadow that clings to your body has begun to reveal disturbances that do not belong wholly to the physical world.
While you are in Shadow Stance, you gain Spirit Sense as a tertiary sense with a range of 15 feet. When using Search, you can detect the presence and general direction of disembodied spirits, incorporeal undead, haunts and active possession within this range.
You also gain a +1-racial bonus to saving throws against possession while Shadow Stance is active.

Works automatically: Spirit Sense (15 ft, tertiary) is on your senses list — the book grants it only in Shadow Stance; +1 racial to saves against possession is offered (tick while in the stance).

sense.name: Spirit Sense
sense.finds: disembodied spirits, incorporeal undead, haunts and active possession

creatureAbility.source: Pillars of Faith, Chapter 5 (Shadowed Soul) — while in Shadow Stance

conditionals.label: Shadowed Soul
